description: The marketing team has added a wide technical specification table to the 'Business Laptop Pro' description, but it's being cut off by the sidebar. Configure this specific product (SKU: LAPTOP-001) to use a '1 column' layout to give it more space. Additionally, move the product options block to the 'Product Info Column' to optimize the layout. Do not change the global theme or layout for other products. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
